value.rationale: The two natural twenty-vertex cubic graphs have the same distance-shell profile, yet exhibit different total-domination-game values and fundamentally different distance-characterized reply choices. A complete ordered-opening classification is a mathematically motivated small graph benchmark for adversarial-game strategies, not an arbitrary slice or rebranded known bound. Its exact first strategic divergence may inform proposed generalizations, though no downstream theorem is asserted.
